eb90_artifact.coverage_note: eb90 resolves ONLY the depth family (exports eglGetProcAddress + the only gl* name strings are these 4). b1c9->eb90 adds the double->float semantic stubs: glDepthRange->glDepthRangef, glClearDepth->glClearDepthf (NOT no-ops).

root_cause_class: OH GLES driver exports the ES float depth variants (glDepthRangef/glClearDepthf) but NOT the desktop double variants (glDepthRange/glClearDepth). Impeller's ProcTable resolves BOTH via eglGetProcAddress; the double variants come back null; calling a null slot -> SIGSEGV in libflutter raster. eb90 provides the 4 depth procs.
